definitions.gloss: field bindweed (Calystegia japonica); related Calystegia species
definitions.explanation: A creeping vine with pale pink, trumpet-shaped flowers that open during the daytime. Common as a wildflower along roadsides and field edges in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道端|みちばた}→道端：28126_michibata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{昼顔|ひるがお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Bindweed is blooming by the roadside.

examples.japanese: {昼顔|ひるがお}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昼間|ひるま}→昼間：01713_hiruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: Bindweed opens its flowers in the daytime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{淡|あわ}い→淡い：13293_awai⟧⟦ピンク→ピンク：04718_pinku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{昼顔|ひるがお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{土手|どて}→土手：12051_dote⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Pale pink bindweed flowers had spread across the riverbank.

notes:
Named from ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧ (daytime) + {顔|がお} (face), reflecting that the flowers open during the day. Forms a set with ⟦{朝顔|あさがお}→朝顔：05001_asagao⟧ (morning glory) and ⟦{夕顔|ゆうがお}→夕顔：28687_yuugao⟧ (moonflower).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昼顔|ひるがお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧: bindweed blooms
- ⟦{野生|やせい}→野生：14439_yasei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{昼顔|ひるがお}: wild bindweed

CULTURAL NOTE:
The word also became widely associated with the 2014 TV drama "{昼顔|ひるがお}〜⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧{午後3時|ごごさんじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{恋人|こいびと}→恋人：02724_koibito⟧たち〜", giving {昼顔|ひるがお} a colloquial second meaning of "daytime affair (between married people)" in modern usage.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朝顔|あさがお}→朝顔：05001_asagao⟧: morning glory — opens in morning
- ⟦{夕顔|ゆうがお}→夕顔：28687_yuugao⟧: moonflower (bottle gourd) — opens in evening
